fusions.name: Galloping Strike
fusions.desc: You rush up to 8 tiles to an enemy and bite, dealing 16 poison damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stampede of Scales
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you takes 26 poison damage, ignoring resistance. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Sidewinder Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Gathering Pace
fusions.desc: Every bite you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, the stacks fade.
